text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, some time after full-scale 
preparations for the debut race had begun, 
I received a phone call from my former 
mentor.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be near Tracen Academy this weekend. 
Do you mind if I drop by?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Oh, really? I'd absolutely love to!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Don't be ridiculous. That's already your 
job. I'm truly just going to watch. ...See 
you later, then."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... I've really got to fire myself up 
for this! If only to put Sensei's mind at 
ease!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, let's prepare thoroughly and give it 
our best!

Yeah, let's prepare thoroughly and give it 
our all!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"A-Ah, found them! These are the ones, 
right? Your favorite seaweed rice 
crackers, Sensei!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Peeling off the nori and eating it! 
Right?!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Rice crackers, check. Oolong tea, check. 
...Now, as for Sensei's lunch...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Especially the kind that's written as 
"Chuka Soba" on the menu!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Do you think there's a ramen shop like 
that around here?"
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's look for one! And make a 
reservation while we're at it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After meticulous planning, the day finally 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Teacher!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah. Morning to ya.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I've prepared some tea and snacks over 
here, so please help yourselves! Well 
then, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Ah, hey...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Alright... Now for the main event. Time to 
pump ourselves up and train!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—...Narita Top Road! Ten cornering dashes! 
Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaahhh--!!
choice_data_list:
Not yet! Is that really the best you've 
got!?

Not yet! Is that really the best you've 
got!?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
“...Are they always like this...? No, 
surely not...”

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"...Is it because I'm watching? Good 
grief... Looks like someone's getting a 
lecture."

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
――All of you, every single one. What good 
does it do to train while staring at me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Make as many mistakes as you want. Just 
make sure you don't lose sight of your 
goal.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"...Knowing you two, scolding you once 
should be enough. Understood?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting~! Three bowls of chuka 
soba!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Here it is. First things first, let's 
grab some food.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, the food here is delicious. ...Come 
to think of it, rumor has it you guys are 
doing something with ramen?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes, an event called the "Ramen Jamboree" 
to express our gratitude to our fans!
choice_data_list:
We come up with and make local ramen 
varieties from all over the country.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Ho? ...In that case, let me try some of 
your ramen someday too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ! Yes, understood!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since the teacher said they were heading 
straight home, I saw them off in front of 
the shop.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Treating the teacher to ramen, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"If they're going to have ramen, you'd 
want them to have the best possible bowl, 
right...?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Still, the reason we make ramen is 
ultimately for our fans. Losing sight of 
our purpose would be...
choice_data_list:
Ah, couldn't you just think of them 
separately?
Ah, why not think of them separately?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You just mustn't lose sight of your 
objective; having multiple goals in itself 
isn't a problem.
choice_data_list:
I know it'll be really tough... but even 
so,

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...You want to take on this challenge for 
Sensei's sake, right? I feel the exact 
same way, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—Let's do this! We're making two kinds of 
the "ultimate ramen" for our fans and 
Sensei!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
As long as I'm with you, Trainer, we can 
see this through to the end! ...After all, 
we're Sensei's disciples!
